create_unit_generator: create a UnitYGenerator instance for speech-to-text and speech-to-unit translation with configurable beam search options
configure_generator_options: configure SequenceGeneratorOptions with beam size, max length, and length penalty for text or unit generation
run_speech_to_text_translation: run speech-to-text translation by calling UnitYGenerator with source speech sequences and target language
run_text_to_unit_generation: run text-to-unit generation by calling UnitYGenerator with source text sequences and output modality set to speech
remove_repeated_ngrams: remove consecutive repeated ngrams from a unit token sequence with configurable min and max ngram size
